display.summary: Deleting keeps history: bulk deletes on scoped models are soft, and users that records point at are deactivated instead of erased.
highlights: Bulk delete on scoped models (including the Django admin's "delete selected") now soft-deletes; queryset.hard_delete() and queryset.restore() are new.
The Django admin and Reset data only soft-delete users that any record, log or admin log entry points at; users with no history are still removed.
Models can opt out of Reset data with dlux_reset = False.
